title: Modem Control
text: Control state of RTS and DTR output lines on serial port, 2 inputs, {Serial port} sets Port that is being accessed Legacy Serial Port; {RTS} and {DTR}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: RTS
ports.summary: Level-sensitive signal for setting ready-to-send line double

ports.name: DTR
ports.summary: Level-sensitive signal for setting data-terminal-ready line double

params.name: RTS
params.values: Enable control of RTS line for serial device on (default) | off

params.name: DTR
params.values: Enable control of DTR line for serial device on (default) | off

params.name: Serial port
params.values: Port that is being accessed Legacy Serial Port 1 (default) |.. | Legacy Serial Port 8 | USB Serial Port 1 |.. | USB Serial Port 8
